newsitem.title: USA: U.S. stock index futures rally further.
newsitem.headline: U.S. stock index futures rally further.

text.p: May 2 - U.S. stock index futures rose further to new highs. June S&P 500s cleared 811.40, the March 12 settlement, and hit buystops near 812.50 on heavy dealer buying, brokers said. Buying revived by news senior US admin. official said Wht Hse, Republicans reached a balanced budget agreement. Next key resistance near 816.90. Firm close in T-bond futures helped.
